item.title: South Korean School Creates 3D-Printed Yearbooks for Visually Impaired Students
item.description: South Korean School Creates 3D-Printed Yearbooks for Visually Impaired Students Graduates at Daegu Kwangmyeong School in South Korea recently received yearbooks unlike any others. Instead of traditional photographs, these students, who are visually impaired, were given 3D-printed yearbooks that allow them to experience their school memories through touch.
